Definition: masculine from G5015; a disturbance, i.e. (popular) tumult:--stir.
BiblicalUsage: The word is a stir, a tumult among people. When Peter escaped from prison there was no small stir among the soldiers, what was become of Peter; and at Ephesus there arose no small stir about the Way.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the gospel stirs a city whether it frees a prisoner or threatens a trade.
